method: Independent binary SMF/VLQ/running-status decoder, no mido or transform code reused. Compare every retained absolute event including raw channel/meta payloads and unchanged header; global unique-active-key trace.
limitations: Trace uses one active key per channel/pitch. It does not recover notation voices, overlapping same-key envelope semantics or the original tied voice.
No audio rendering equivalence established; derived is a separate unadmitted/unscreened candidate, not a corrected musical ground truth.
